formalizer_output_smtlib:
; Rule: r_ce8781295a93  |  Line: 0
; NL: "A call to apply a refund of type GOODWILL_CREDIT is not permitted if the sum of the customer's recent goodwill credit total and the proposed refund amount exceeds 50,000 pence."
(assert (forall ((r RefundCall))
  (=> (and (= (refund-type-of r) goodwill-credit)
           (> (+ (recent-goodwill-credit-total (affected-customer r))
                 (refund-amount-pence r))
              50000))
      (not (is-permitted r)))))
